t: This is the Church of St John the Evangelist, in Angell Town, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It takes its name from John the Evangelist, the figure traditionally named as the author of the Gospel of John. Christians have long identified him with John the Apostle and with John of Patmos, though there's no agreement on whether they were really the same person. I don't have more detail on the building itself, so take a moment to look at it and see what you notice.
